items.message:
@replay : ∀ {σ : Type u_2} (f d e : σ →₀ ℕ),
  hasseCoeff d (f + d) * hasseCoeff e (f + d + e) = hasseCoeff d (d + e) * hasseCoeff (d + e) (f + (d + e))

@hasseDeriv_hasseDeriv : ∀ {σ : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] (d e : σ →₀ ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (hasseDeriv d) ((hasseDeriv e) P) = ↑(hasseCoeff d (d + e)) • (hasseDeriv (d + e)) P

@hasseDeriv_hasseDeriv_of_disjoint : ∀ {σ : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] {d e : σ →₀ ℕ},
  Disjoint d.support e.support → ∀ (P : MvPolynomial σ R), (hasseDeriv d) ((hasseDeriv e) P) = (hasseDeriv (d + e)) P

@Finsupp.disjoint_iff : ∀ {ι : Type u_3} {α : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α]
  [inst_2 : IsBotZeroClass α] {f g : ι →₀ α}, Disjoint f g ↔ Disjoint f.support g.support

@pderiv_hasseDeriv : ∀ {σ : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] (j : σ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ)
  (P : MvPolynomial σ R), (pderiv j) ((hasseDeriv d) P) = ↑(d j + 1) • (hasseDeriv (d + Finsupp.single j 1)) P

@degreeOf_hasseDeriv_le : ∀ {σ : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] (j : σ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ)
  (P : MvPolynomial σ R), degreeOf j ((hasseDeriv d) P) ≤ degreeOf j P

@hasseDeriv_eq_zero_of_degreeOf_lt : ∀ {σ : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] {j : σ} {d : σ →₀ ℕ}
  {P : MvPolynomial σ R}, degreeOf j P < d j → (hasseDeriv d) P = 0

@hasseDeriv_mul_of_degreeOf_eq_zero : ∀ {σ : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] {d : σ →₀ ℕ}
  {f g : MvPolynomial σ R}, (∀ j ∈ d.support, degreeOf j f = 0) → (hasseDeriv d) (f * g) = f * (hasseDeriv d) g

@mem_vars_iff_degreeOf_ne_zero : ∀ {R : Type u_3} {σ : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {i : σ},
  i ∈ p.vars ↔ degreeOf i p ≠ 0

@pderiv_mul : ∀ {R : Type u_3} {σ : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] {i : σ} {f g : MvPolynomial σ R},
  (pderiv i) (f * g) = (pderiv i) f * g + f * (pderiv i) g

@linearMap_ext : ∀ {R : Type u_3} {σ : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] {M : Type u_5} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] {f g : MvPolynomial σ R →ₗ[R] M}, (∀ (s : σ →₀ ℕ), f ∘ₗ monomial s = g ∘ₗ monomial s) → f = g

@Polynomial.hasseDeriv_monomial : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k n : ℕ) (r : R),
  (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) ((Polynomial.monomial n) r) = (Polynomial.monomial (n - k)) (↑(n.choose k) * r)

@Polynomial.toMvPolynomial : {R : Type u_1} →
  {σ : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → σ → Polynomial R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial σ R
